pool.text: [NSMO of KSA — Mawhiba IMO Camp] What is the **maximum** number of edges in a simple graph on \( n = 9 \) vertices that contains no complete subgraph \( K_{4} \) (illustrated by the balanced \( 3 \)-partite Turán graph)?

Every pair of parts contributes \( 3^2 \) edges, giving \( \binom{3}{2} \cdot 3^2 = 3 \cdot 9 = 27 \) edges.
